name: Drinking And Smoking
overview: Scripture warns clearly against the dangers of excessive drinking and its consequences. Proverbs 20:1 highlights that wine and strong drink can deceive and lead to unwise behavior, while Isaiah 5 and 28 describe how overindulgence causes moral and spiritual failure, even among leaders. Habakkuk condemns enabling others to become drunk for selfish reasons, and Luke 21:34 cautions believers to guard their hearts against being weighed down by drunkenness and the cares of life, lest they be caught unprepared for the coming day.
